protocol.scope: Bounded exploratory M3 diagnostic follow-up; not a new untouched-test result
protocol.selection_metric: inner grouped cross-validation mean log loss
protocol.projection_distribution: fixed independent Rademacher signs divided by sqrt(output dimension); no fitted projection
protocol.feature_positions: 81 cell positions in the 89-token full prefix latent; eight row separator positions excluded from spatial variants
protocol.cheap_control_selection: choose family and C using inner folds within each outer training partition
protocol.calibration_policy: new exploratory discrimination uses uncalibrated raw margins; no test-driven recalibration or sign inversion
protocol.interval_limitations: paired puzzle-cluster percentile intervals conditional on fitted cross-validation models; models not refitted in bootstrap; exploratory selection and fold uncertainty not fully represented
protocol.no_fresh_data_policy: finish exploratory diagnostics, preserve negative result, and keep M4-M7 gated; do not relabel exposed puzzles or symmetry transforms as fresh
protocol.hardware_policy: existing local GPU for prefix reconstruction only; one CPU thread for fitting; no paid compute or new checkpoint downloads
protocol.manual_review: agent case walkthrough with raw input/output and independent constraint witnesses; not a human annotation study
protocol.stopping_rule: evaluate exactly these two spatial variants at the two declared levels once; no extra seeds, levels, models, or hyperparameters selected from results

claims: Research measurements only; no intervention or safety effectiveness established.
aggregation: sample-weighted mean of outer-fold AUROCs is primary; pooled out-of-fold AUROC is descriptive secondary
error: ValueError: Prefix decoding differs from the audited current board
